name: scenix
description: AI-driven UI automation testing platform powered by Midscene.js and Appium

scripts.build: pnpm build:core && pnpm --filter client build && pnpm --filter server build
scripts.test:unit: pnpm build:core && pnpm --filter core exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts --root .. tests/server tests/client
scripts.test:live: pnpm build:core && pnpm --filter core exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts --root .. tests/web tests/android tests/ios
scripts.test:web: pnpm build:core && pnpm --filter core exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts --root .. tests/web/search.test.ts
scripts.test:android: pnpm build:core && pnpm --filter core exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts --root .. tests/android/ebay-search.test.ts
scripts.test:ios: pnpm build:core && pnpm --filter core exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts --root .. tests/ios/settings.test.ts
